function.description: Show the durable conversation history with an external correspondent (what we sent and what they replied, across sessions). Omit surface+address to LIST all conversations (who replied, who has not). Read-only.
function.name: contact_history

parameters.description:
Read the durable conversation history with an external correspondent —
what we sent and what they replied, across sessions (survives compaction).
Omit surface+address to LIST all conversations (who was contacted, who
replied, who hasn't answered yet).

address.description: Correspondent address (email address / chat id); omit to list all conversations

surface.description: Surface id, e.g. 'email', 'telegram', 'x' (omit together with address to list all conversations)
